verses.ar: «لِمَاذَا إِذْ لَمْ تَخْتَبِئِ ٱلْأَزْمِنَةُ مِنَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ، لَا يَرَى عَارِفُوهُ يَوْمَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.web: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

verses.ar: يَنْقُلُونَ ٱلتُّخُومَ. يَغْتَصِبُونَ قَطِيعًا وَيَرْعَوْنَهُ.
verses.kjv: [Some] remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed [thereof].
verses.web: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

verses.ar: يَسْتَاقُونَ حِمَارَ ٱلْيَتَامَى، وَيَرْتَهِنُونَ ثَوْرَ ٱلْأَرْمَلَةِ.
verses.kjv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.web: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

verses.ar: يَصُدُّونَ ٱلْفُقَرَاءَ عَنِ ٱلطَّرِيقِ. مَسَاكِينُ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْتَبِئُونَ جَمِيعًا.
verses.kjv: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.web: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

verses.ar: هَا هُمْ كَٱلْفَرَاءِ فِي ٱلْقَفْرِ يَخْرُجُونَ إِلَى عَمَلِهِمْ يُبَكِّرُونَ لِلطَّعَامِ. ٱلْبَادِيَةُ لَهُمْ خُبْزٌ لِأَوْلَادِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Behold, [as] wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness [yieldeth] food for them [and] for [their] children.
verses.web: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ يَحْصُدُونَ عَلَفَهُمْ، وَيُعَلِّلُونَ كَرْمَ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ.
verses.kjv: They reap [every one] his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.web: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

verses.ar: يَبِيتُونَ عُرَاةً بِلَا لِبْسٍ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ كُسْوَةٌ فِي ٱلْبَرْدِ.
verses.kjv: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that [they have] no covering in the cold.
verses.web: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

verses.ar: يَبْتَلُّونَ مِنْ مَطَرِ ٱلْجِبَالِ، وَلِعَدَمِ ٱلْمَلْجَإِ يَعْتَنِقُونَ ٱلصَّخْرَ.
verses.kjv: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.web: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

verses.ar: «يَخْطَفُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ عَنِ ٱلثُّدِيِّ، وَمِنَ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ يَرْتَهِنُونَ.
verses.kjv: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.web: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

verses.ar: عُرَاةً يَذْهَبُونَ بِلَا لِبْسٍ، وَجَائِعِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ حُزَمًا.
verses.kjv: They cause [him] to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf [from] the hungry;
verses.web: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

verses.ar: يَعْصِرُونَ ٱلزَّيْتَ دَاخِلَ أَسْوَارِهِمْ. يَدُوسُونَ ٱلْمَعَاصِرَ وَيَعْطَشُونَ.
verses.kjv: [Which] make oil within their walls, [and] tread [their] winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.web: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلْوَجَعِ أُنَاسٌ يَئِنُّونَ، وَنَفْسُ ٱلْجَرْحَى تَسْتَغِيثُ، وَٱللهُ لَا يَنْتَبِهُ إِلَى ٱلظُّلْمِ.
verses.kjv: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly [to them].
verses.web: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

verses.ar: «أُولَئِكَ يَكُونُونَ بَيْنَ ٱلْمُتَمَرِّدِينَ عَلَى ٱلنُّورِ. لَا يَعْرِفُونَ طُرُقَهُ وَلَا يَلْبَثُونَ فِي سُبُلِهِ.
verses.kjv: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.web: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

verses.ar: مَعَ ٱلنُّورِ يَقُومُ ٱلْقَاتِلُ، يَقْتُلُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱلْفَقِيرَ، وَفِي ٱللَّيْلِ يَكُونُ كَٱللِّصِّ.
verses.kjv: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.web: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

verses.ar: وَعَيْنُ ٱلزَّانِي تُلَاحِظُ ٱلْعِشَاءَ. يَقُولُ: لَا تُرَاقِبُنِي عَيْنٌ. فَيَجْعَلُ سِتْرًا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ.
verses.kjv: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth [his] face.
verses.web: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

verses.ar: يَنْقُبُونَ ٱلْبُيُوتَ فِي ٱلظَّلَامِ. فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ يُغْلِقُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ. لَا يَعْرِفُونَ ٱلنُّورَ.
verses.kjv: In the dark they dig through houses, [which] they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.web: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلصَّبَاحُ وَظِلُّ ٱلْمَوْتِ. لِأَنَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ أَهْوَالَ ظِلِّ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: For the morning [is] to them even as the shadow of death: if [one] know [them, they are in] the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.web: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

verses.ar: خَفِيفٌ هُوَ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ. مَلْعُونٌ نَصِيبُهُمْ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. لَا يَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَى طَرِيقِ ٱلْكُرُومِ.
verses.kjv: He [is] swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.web: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

verses.ar: ٱلْقَحْطُ وَٱلْقَيْظُ يَذْهَبَانِ بِمِيَاهِ ٱلثَّلْجِ، كَذَا ٱلْهَاوِيَةُ بِٱلَّذِينَ أَخْطَأُوا.
verses.kjv: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: [so doth] the grave [those which] have sinned.
verses.web: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

verses.ar: تَنْسَاهُ ٱلرَّحِمُ، يَسْتَحْلِيهِ ٱلدُّودُ. لَا يُذْكَرُ بَعْدُ، وَيَنْكَسِرُ ٱلْأَثِيمُ كَشَجَرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.web: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

verses.ar: يُسِيءُ إِلَى ٱلْعَاقِرِ ٱلَّتِي لَمْ تَلِدْ، وَلَا يُحْسِنُ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْمَلَةِ.
verses.kjv: He evil entreateth the barren [that] beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.web: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

verses.ar: يُمْسِكُ ٱلْأَعِزَّاءَ بِقُوَّتِهِ. يَقُومُ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ أَحَدٌ بِحَيَاتِهِ.
verses.kjv: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no [man] is sure of life.
verses.web: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

verses.ar: يُعْطِيهِ طُمَأْنِينَةً فَيَتَوَكَّلُ، وَلَكِنْ عَيْنَاهُ عَلَى طُرُقِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: [Though] it be given him [to be] in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes [are] upon their ways.
verses.web: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

verses.ar: يَتَرَفَّعُونَ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُونَ وَيُحَطُّونَ. كَٱلْكُلِّ يُجْمَعُونَ، وَكَرَأْسِ ٱلسُّنْبُلَةِ يُقْطَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all [other], and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.web: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ كَذَا، فَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُنِي وَيَجْعَلُ كَلَامِي لَا شَيْئًا؟».
verses.kjv: And if [it be] not [so] now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.web: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”
